classification.hynek_scaffold: CE1: structured triangular craft observed at close range, rapid vertical ascent
classification.rationale: Public media interview with identified former intelligence specialist; no classification markings; first-hand sighting account and second-hand claims about programs; suitable for standard processing.

_raw_list: Dylan Borland, a former 1N1 geospatial intelligence specialist for the USAF, witnessed a 100 ft equilateral triangle UAP take off from near the NASA hangar at Langley AFB in summer 2012 at approximately 0130 hours.
The object ascended from approximately 100 ft off the ground to at least 30,000 ft (commercial jet elevation) in 2 to 3 seconds.

After this sighting, while working at BAE, someone in the government who was read into a secret UAP program mistakenly believed Borland was also read in and disclosed knowledge about a 'very specific program' to him.
Borland asserts 'I am sure there are crafts that were not made by humanity at this current time and place when we recovered them.'
The Intelligence Community Inspector General (ICIG) 'extremely hinted at' the idea that humans are not in charge.
An ODNI agent told journalist Jeremy Corbell that a UFO reverse-engineering program is called 'Rubik's Cube', and Borland implies Corbell's account is accurate without confirming it directly.
Borland was subjected to administrative reprisals, including a polygraph with flashing images and air horns while counting backwards by 7, which he describes as part of retaliation.
The Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) allegedly committed a felony by disclosing whistleblower testimony to a journalist.
